title: bind local lifecycle operation intent catalog

criteria: Catalog binds install, update, repair/reinstall, downgrade/rollback, support export, and recovery reference intents to RC20 release/channel/consumer evidence.

Catalog is local-only and does not authorize host mutation, active artifact set mutation, production ring mutation, remote dispatch, support upload, recovery execution, signer authority, object storage, or GA claims.
Catalog records exact required inputs, audit expectations, and denial reasons for missing or stale RC20 evidence.
